name: Raman Dhiman
tagline: Singer, music producer, actor and script writer.
bio: Raman Dhiman is a singer, music producer, actor and script writer who releases music under his own name. His official pages are where new songs and updates appear first.

His catalogue on Apple Music runs from Jhooth and Dunali in 2021, through Debat (2022) and Patloo (2023), to Fame, Akdan and Shokeen Kudte Pajame De in 2024 and Panjab in 2025. Along the way he has worked with Navdeep Bhatti, Sam Star and Sammy K.
